_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}  ki  khwai Surround, {width}x{height}  ki  lamdamda  me.
Nangdi  player {player_id}  ni.  Thokpa  thouram: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]'  amata  w/s/a/d.
Maram: anisabada  khudingi  thouram  amata  nangdi  kaya  thaba  purni;  hawaida  chenba  purni;  makhei  chenba  purni  aduga  anisuba  purni.

outcome.all_crashed: খেলোয়াড়সিং অন্যসিংদা একই সময়দা ক্রাশ তৌবা।
outcome.outlived: খেলোয়াড়সিং মাতাংদা মতাংদা অন্যসিংদা পোক্তাবা অমা।
outcome.turn_limit: টার্ন লিমিট চেতলে - সবচেয়ে লম্বা সময় বাঁচনবা খেলোয়াড় জিতনবা।
